BGPConfiguration bindMode None listens without address restriction rather than disabling BGP; nodeMeshPassword authenticates mesh rather than enabling IPv4. nodeMeshMaxRestartTime requires duration string and only scopes automatic mesh.

Corrected explicit IPv4/IPv6 BIRD sockets, actualprotocolnames, node-vs-workstation diagnostics. Multi-rack/DC examples retain AS-loop,returnroute,failure-domain requirements. Repaired RFC5082 label/source links and Korean previous-guide label.

Current baseline Calico3.32.2 and Kubernetes-tested1.34–1.36; standard aggregated API/Kubernetes datastore prerequisites explicit. Examples use isolated demo namespace and are separate patterns, not production-tested manifest bundle.

Corrected Kubernetes additive allow/endpoint-direction semantics, same-entry namespace+pod AND vs separate-entry OR, reply behavior, existing-connection/NAT limits, and existing named-port/endPort support.

Fixed duplicate selector/destination YAML keys, numeric-port protocol omissions, server destination-v-source ports, namespace identity labels, global(expr) selector misuse, literal namespace/tenant interpolation, and broad cluster/system/host selection.

Tier source constants default1e6/kube-admin1e3/kube-baseline1e7, selectedendpoint+direction/defaultActionDeny, Profilefallback and hoststageexceptions corrected. Removed earlyPass that bypassed later PCI/restricted-data policy; security/platformdefaultActionPass preserves checkingallguardrails.

findings: Fully read original EN1186/KO911 guide lines and EN198/KO198 quiz lines; all24questions retained and answers aligned. All17 figures actually viewed;10 retained with scope captions,7 redundant/inaccurate references removed; assets unchanged.

Calico3.32.2 IPAM implementation/public schema default maxBlocksPerHost0 differs from reference prose20; explained default discrepancy and positive-cap strictAffinity constraint. IPPool CIDR/blockSize immutable; explicit pool selection bypasses selectors; BlockAffinity read-only/state/deletion/type filtering corrected. Removed unsafe invented release --block and private-key reads.

WireGuard peer/inter-node scope, real booleans/IPv6 and keepalive-vs-rekey distinction corrected. Both original differing EN/KO crypto benchmark records preserved in both languages as unverified historical data; no invented performance guarantee or protocol-level FIPS certification.

Commercial EgressGateway uses operator.tigera.io/v1 and released operator schema; namespace selection, Calico CNI prerequisites, routable owned address pool, SNAT source and L7/source-identity limits explicit. NetworkPolicy/BGP advertisement alone does not implement a gateway. Federation distributes remote endpoint identity, not policies; Service selector annotation and matching namespace/named port/protocol corrected.

Windows current operator/HPC/HNS, IPv4-only/VXLANAlways/BGP alternatives, four reserved addresses and platform exclusions documented. Published Kubernetes1.36 and Calico OS-list intersection is Server2022; no unsupported universal Windows compatibility assertion. StrictAffinity merge patch preserves existing settings.

Typha exact operator1.42.6 formula corrected; unsupported replicas/env overrides and unsafe generic tuning removed. Refresh interval is not API polling; NFT iptables backend is not native Nftables dataplane. etcd capacity/presets and product performance/pricing claims bounded to evidence.

Broken official Egress/performance URLs replaced with fetched primary references. Public BlockAffinity deleted defaulting/old API alias means original strict-schema candidates are not all proven runtime errors. NIST403 is access uncertainty, not proven missing content.
